assumptions: Path: metrics/mod.rs:2416-2419 -> classical::score(Kind::Ssim) -> ssim_streamed, classical.rs:746-768 + band_ssim:773-854. sRGB8 RGB interleaved, per channel independently, mean over W*H*C.

v2 conventions: streaming band overlap (SSIM_BAND=64, RING=11) recomputes xform + horizontal blur on the 10 shared rows per band boundary: overlap elements = W*10*(NB-1)*C, NB=ceil(H/64) - counted as separate class 'implementation' stages (xform_ovr, hblur_ovr).

Border convention: interior tap loop (11 mul + 10 add per element) counted for all elements. Border columns use htap with one extra add plus reflect() index arithmetic; border rows use reflected ring slots at identical per-element cost.

vblur is written as a running accumulator over ring rows (acc[w] per plane): counted as the equivalent FIR (11 loads + 1 store per element); the ~10 extra row-buffer read-modify-writes per element in acc[] are implementation scratch traffic, not image-buffer traffic.
5 convolved planes per pixel: a, b, a^2, b^2, a*b (mu1, mu2, sigma1^2, sigma2^2, sigma12). kernel11() setup (11 exp + normalize) is once per call, excluded.
l*c map folds into a scalar per (band, channel); the mean over bands/channels is a separate small reduction. Rust does not contract a*b+c into FMA; all arithmetic f64.
rayon: bands dispatched in parallel, identical per-element work.
bytes_* = compulsory traffic (input planes read once, output written once); per-tap stencil reads are only in 'load'.

stages.name: u8->f64 normalize + a2/b2/ab product rows
stages.notes: av,bv = px/255 (u8->f64 cvt + div each); a2=av*av, b2=bv*bv, ab=av*bv (3 mul); 5 f64 row-buffer stores. Joint stage over both images (images=1: ops already cover both).

stages.name: xform recomputed on 10-row band overlaps
stages.notes: Same per-element ops as xform, on rows shared by adjacent bands (ring warm-up). No depends_on: reads the original input grid, not xform output.

stages.name: 11-tap Gaussian, horizontal, 5 planes
stages.notes: gaussian_interior writes acc = src[k0]*k0 then 10 taps acc += src*ki -> 11 mul + 10 add; htap border form is 11 mul + 11 add + reflect() indexing (not counted).

stages.name: hblur recomputed on 10-row band overlaps
stages.notes: Same taps as hblur, on overlap rows.

stages.name: 11-tap Gaussian, vertical, 5 planes
stages.notes: accumulate into acc[5*w] row buffers: per output element per plane acc = k0*v then 10x acc += ki*v. Counted as logical FIR; border rows selected via reflected ring slots (same per-element cost).

stages.name: l*c SSIM terms + per-(band,channel) partial sum
stages.notes: va=(aa-ma^2).max(0), vb likewise, cov=ab-ma*mb, l=(2*ma*mb+c1)/(ma^2+mb^2+c1), c=(2*cov+c2)/(va+vb+c2), partial += l*c. mul 9, add 10, div 2, cmp 2, load 5.

stages.name: sum 3 channel partials per band, /n
stages.notes: sum += (p0+p1+p2)/n per band; the 3 stores are the band's channel partials written by band_ssim.

stages.name: sum/3 -> mean over channels
stages.notes: score()/3.0 at the call site; cvt is the one-time (w*h) as f64.
